Those are gameplay recommendations, not claims of real-world wealth. The description also lists Prime Gaming discounts and a sign-up link, but the supplied evidence does not establish a fraudulent destination or harmful data flow. The observable conduct is guidance on missions, virtual items, and in-game rewards, with the external sign-up presented as an optional resource.
